stepExplanation:
The maximum EMF for an AC generator is:
$$\varepsilon_{max} = NAB\omega$$
$$\varepsilon_{max} = 150 \times 0.04 \times 0.5 \times 314$$
$$\varepsilon_{max} = 150 \times 0.04 \times 0.5 \times 314 = 942 \text{ V}$$
stepBody: Using ε_max = NABω, calculate the maximum EMF. Given: N = 150, A = 0.04 m², B = 0.5 T, ω = 314 rad/s. Give your answer in Volts.
